name: Until Dawn 2: Digital Deluxe Edition
storyline: A team of secretly skeptical ghost hunters lands a TV deal after one of their social media stunts goes viral. Their new gig takes them to an abandoned resort on a remote desert island, where a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena promises a killer television debut.
summary:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Until Dawn 2
• Y2K Neon Vibes Pack – Themed costumes for all eight playable characters
• Dioramas of Death – A Gallery to view each death in gruesome detail
